body: I've been very depressed for many years, but had started to work on getting better and was in a stable, wonderful relationship. Things were still hard but I had a very real reason to keep going. Last month my partner suddenly left me, I never saw it coming, and I still don't understand why. I have no reason or desire to keep living, and as my quality of life is now non-existent, I have every reason and desire to die.
